### Obedience Leads to Blessings
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-january-20-2025.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 28:2, 6
Points:
- God's promised blessings in Scripture are conditional rather than automatic.
- When believers feel they are waiting on God, He may be waiting for their obedience.
- God's promises of provision apply directly to daily family life and work.
- The Lord intends His visible blessings to serve as a testimony of His goodness.
- Following God's guidance unlocks the blessings He has prepared for His people.

### Blessings and Curses
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-november-17-2024.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 28:2, 15
Points:
- Moses set a high-stakes choice before Israel between covenant blessing and judgment.
- Believers remain vulnerable to temptation and depend entirely on sustaining grace.
- Assuming one could never fall away into disbelief is a perilous mistake.
- God establishes His commands for our good rather than to rob us of joy.
- Christ took the curse of our disobedience so we could receive His blessings.

### Bible Pathway - Mar. 10, 2010
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-mar-10-2010-11627292.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 28:1, 12
Points:
- Receiving the Lord's bounty is inseparably linked to obedience to His Word.
- Disobedience carries consequences, but not all human suffering results from personal sin.
- Material wealth does not necessarily indicate God's spiritual approval.
- Victory over temptation comes from the Holy Spirit rather than human willpower.
